design.decision: When one partner bids nil, the other should bid as high as the hand allows, because every contract trick also grows the nil.
design.opponent: Revealed when a nil is made; opponents learn that a big contract beside a nil is doubly worth setting.
design.rationale: Joins Nil and Bid High and scales with contract size (bid tension), filling a nil-points shape the registry lacks.
design.draftText: +20 nil points for each trick in your team's contract
